help:metadata.help:title: Rubber Band 4.0.0: Complete Command-Line Help
help:metadata.help:subtitle: Offline time stretching, tempo conversion, pitch shifting, and dynamic ratio maps
help:metadata.help:abstract: rubberband-r3 reads one audio file through libsndfile, changes duration and pitch independently with the Rubber Band R2 or R3 engine, and writes one output file. This manual covers every option accepted by the local executable, ratio and map semantics, engine-specific tuning, output-format selection, clipping recovery, processing passes, diagnostics, exit behavior, and reproducible workflows.
help:metadata.help:document-status: Verified against the local executable's --help, --full-help, and --version output and the upstream v4.0.0 command-line source.

help:verification-notes.help:note: The local executable name ends in -r3.exe, so R3 is selected unless --fast is given.
Normal and full help are written to standard error and return status 2; --version returns status 0.

help:semantic-model.help:title: Reference model
help:semantic-model.help:description: Every accepted switch has a stable ID. Rules capture parser requirements and option precedence; workflows and troubleshooting link back to those IDs; sources identify the local and upstream evidence.
help:semantic-model.help:authority: The exact local v4.0.0 executable and matching v4.0.0 source outrank generic or newer online examples.

help:example.help:description: Make the recording 50% longer and transpose it upward by two semitones with the default R3 engine.

help:requirements.help:item: Supply exactly one input and one output positional argument.
Supply at least one time, pitch, frequency, pitch-map, or frequency-map option; a neutral value such as --pitch 0 satisfies the parser.
Use a positive aggregate time ratio. Input and output must be formats supported by the bundled libsndfile.

help:topic.help:title: Ratios, tempo, duration, and pitch
help:topic.help:description: Time and frequency are independent. A time ratio above 1 lengthens the output; a tempo multiplier above 1 shortens it because tempo X maps to time ratio 1/X. Repeated --time and --tempo values multiply into one ratio. --duration is resolved after the input header is opened and replaces that accumulated ratio with requested-seconds/input-seconds. Semitone pitch and frequency multipliers combine multiplicatively using frequency-ratio = frequency × 2^(semitones/12).

help:formulas.help:formula: --tempo X:Y gives time ratio X / Y
time ratio = requested duration / input duration

help:exit-statuses.help:status: Invalid ratio, conflicting maps, file/map open or format failure, malformed map, or another processing error.
Help/full-help, missing transformation, unknown option, or wrong positional-argument count.

help:topic.help:title: Dynamic time, pitch, and frequency maps

help:map.help:description: Each nonblank line maps an input sample-frame number to its target output frame. The points define a varying stretch factor. Also supply --time, --tempo, or --duration to establish total duration.
Offsets are relative to the initial --pitch/--frequency setting, not cumulative. The implementation converts each offset with 2^(offset/12).
The second column is a direct frequency multiplier. A pitch map and a frequency map cannot be used together.

help:notes.help:item: Columns are separated by at least one literal space; leading spaces and blank lines are accepted.
Later entries for the same frame replace earlier entries because maps are keyed by frame number.
Pitch/frequency maps force real-time mode and high-consistency pitch processing; exact duration is therefore not guaranteed.

help:stage.name: parse
help:stage.help:description: Parse options, resolve engine defaults and precedence, and read map files.

help:stage.name: open
help:stage.help:description: Open input with libsndfile, derive --duration if present, and open the output.

help:stage.name: study
help:stage.help:description: In offline mode only, make a complete analysis pass and calculate the stretch profile.

help:stage.name: process
help:stage.help:description: Process 1024-frame blocks, apply key-frame or frequency changes, compensate start delay, and write interleaved samples.

help:stage.name: clip-retry
help:stage.help:description: By default, restart from the beginning with reduced gain when clipping is detected, down to a minimum gain of 0.75; thereafter clamp.

help:stage.name: report
help:stage.help:description: Unless quiet, report input/output frames, achieved ratio, duration error, elapsed time, and throughput.

help:format-policy.help:item: If input and output extensions are identical, the output inherits the input format.
If extensions differ and libsndfile recognizes the output extension, the utility selects that container with 24-bit PCM.
If the output extension is unknown, it warns and uses the input format.
Output sample rate and channel count match the input.

help:topic.help:title: R2 crispness presets
help:topic.help:description: These presets apply to R2. Supplying --crisp overrides separately supplied transient, detector, lamination, and window switches.

help:option.help:detail: A single value contributes 1/X to the time ratio; X:Y contributes X/Y.

help:option.help:interaction: After the input header is read, this replaces any ratio accumulated from --time or --tempo.

help:constraints.help:title: Constraints and precedence
help:constraints.help:rule: Exactly two positional arguments—input then output—are required; otherwise help is printed and status 2 returned.

help:rule.option-refs: opt-time opt-tempo opt-duration opt-pitch opt-frequency opt-pitchmap opt-freqmap

help:constraints.help:rule: At least one transformation or dynamic pitch/frequency map must be supplied.
The final time ratio must be greater than zero.ERROR: Invalid time ratio
A nonzero --duration replaces the accumulated --time/--tempo ratio after the input duration is known.
A time map requires an explicit overall time or duration option.
Pitch and frequency maps are mutually exclusive.ERROR: Please specify either pitch map or frequency map, not both
Either pitch map forces real-time processing and high-consistency pitch mode, overriding --pitch-hq.
If both engines are requested, both selections are cleared and the executable-name default is used—R3 for rubberband-r3.exe.

help:rule.option-refs: opt-crisp opt-no-transients opt-bl-transients opt-no-lamination opt-detector-perc opt-detector-soft opt-window-long opt-window-short

help:constraints.help:rule: An explicit crispness preset overrides individual transient, detector, lamination, and window settings.
Debug level 3 can add audible ticks to output and is unsuitable for a production render.
The output is opened for writing before processing; use a distinct path and protect irreplaceable files.

help:workflow.help:title: Make audio 25% longer
help:workflow.help:outcome: Duration grows by about 25%; pitch is unchanged.

help:workflow.help:title: Raise tempo by 20%
help:workflow.help:outcome: Time ratio is 1/1.2, so output is about 83.33% of the input duration.

help:workflow.help:title: Fit exactly thirty seconds
help:workflow.help:note: Requires a reliable sample rate and frame count in the input header.

help:workflow.help:title: Lower-CPU R2 preview
help:workflow.help:note: Audition several crispness presets for source-dependent results.

help:workflow.help:title: Apply a pitch curve
help:workflow.help:precondition: Create pitch.map with lines such as 0 0, 48000 2, and 96000 0.
help:workflow.help:warning: Dynamic pitch maps use real-time mode, so total duration may not be exact.

help:problem.symptom: Help is displayed but the command reports failure/status 2
help:problem.help:cause: Help and usage errors intentionally share exit status 2 in v4.0.0.
help:problem.help:resolution: Use --version for a status-0 probe; treat status 2 as expected only when help was requested deliberately.

help:problem.help:cause: The product of time/tempo ratios is zero or negative.
help:problem.help:resolution: Use positive numeric values; remember that --tempo 0 is converted to a neutral ratio of 1 by this parser, while --time 0 makes the aggregate invalid.

help:problem.symptom: File lacks frame count in header, cannot use --duration
help:problem.help:cause: Exact duration conversion needs the input header's sample rate and frame count.
help:problem.help:resolution: Convert the input to a well-formed seekable WAV/FLAC first, or use --time with a ratio calculated externally.

help:problem.symptom: Map file is malformed at line N
help:problem.help:cause: A nonblank line lacks a literal space separating its two values.
help:problem.help:resolution: Write exactly two numeric columns separated by spaces; remove comments and other text.

help:problem.symptom: Please specify either pitch map or frequency map, not both
help:problem.help:cause: Both dynamic pitch representations were requested.
help:problem.help:resolution: Choose semitone offsets (--pitchmap) or direct multipliers (--freqmap), not both.

help:problem.symptom: Processing restarts after clipping is detected
help:problem.help:cause: The default protection detected a sample outside the representable range and reduced gain.
help:problem.help:resolution: Allow the restart for cleaner output, reduce source level before processing, or deliberately use --ignore-clipping to clamp instead.

help:problem.symptom: Unknown output file extension; input format is used
help:problem.help:cause: libsndfile did not recognize the requested extension.
help:problem.help:resolution: Choose an extension supported by the installed libsndfile, such as .wav or .flac, and verify the resulting container.

help:problem.symptom: R2 tuning switches appear to have no effect
help:problem.help:cause: Most detailed tuning switches are R2-only, or an explicit crispness preset replaced them.
help:problem.help:resolution: Select --fast for R2 and avoid --crisp when setting its component switches manually.

help:term.help:name: Time ratio
help:term.help:definition: Output duration divided by input duration; values above one lengthen audio.

help:term.help:name: Tempo multiplier
help:term.help:definition: Playback-rate change expressed inversely to duration: tempo 2 corresponds to time ratio 0.5.

help:term.help:name: Semitone
help:term.help:definition: One twelfth of an octave; twelve semitones multiply frequency by two.

help:term.help:name: Sample frame
help:term.help:definition: One sample instant across every channel; map positions count frames, not bytes or per-channel samples.

help:term.help:name: R2 / Faster engine
help:term.help:definition: The lower-CPU legacy engine with detailed transient, detector, window, and crispness controls.

help:term.help:name: R3 / Finer engine
help:term.help:definition: The newer, generally higher-quality and higher-CPU engine selected by default by rubberband-r3.exe.

help:term.help:name: Formant
help:term.help:definition: A spectral-envelope resonance important to perceived vocal and instrumental timbre.

help:term.help:name: Real-time mode
help:term.help:definition: A one-pass stretcher configuration; this file utility does not become a live streaming command.
